desc: No bulky plastic molded case needed here everything packs into a rugged weather- resistant polyurethane clad zippered travel case. Experienced shooters will appreciate these ultra versatile cleaning kits made of premium components. Slotted connectors and brushes are made of machined brass and match perfectly with the compact flex rod and T-handle. Designed for real shooters Gun Boss is at home on the bench but really shines whenever a shooter travels. All kits are airline safe. Specifications: - machined aluminum connectors adapters brushes and tips for long life - 3 Nylon clad - Steel cables and t-handle that pack small and are easy to use - Rugged weatherized zip case with two sided tool tray.
